Zomi is 10,000 shielded pixel identities on Robinhood Chain, and each identity is a tokenized bond. One engine composes every one of them in code from a 26 by 26 pixel system across seven layers, drawn off the token id, so the same id always gives the same 676 cells. At mint the holder picks a term of 30, 90 or 180 days, which is written into the token and sets its coupon weight at 1.0x, 1.5x or 2.0x for life. Coupons accrue out of one reserve through a single index: when the reserve grows, the index rises by the growth divided by the total weight of the live issue, and a token's pending coupon is its weight times the move since it last settled, so a claim costs the same gas at ten tokens as at ten thousand. Maturity unlocks the claim in ETH and leaves the accrual running, and a transfer carries the pending coupon to the new holder. Trading feeds the reserve: one percent of every swap in the Uniswap V4 pool with the Zomi hook attached goes into it. A holder can set a Zcash shielded address as the payout route, and only a hash of it goes on chain, with coupons paying in ETH today and the shielded ZEC route next. The engine, the explorer with every id and its rank, the whitepaper and the contract controls page are public; the ZomiBond source carries 107 tests and an internal review with no external audit, and the contract is not deployed yet. Hold the identity, collect the coupon, stay unnamed.

TALIS is an onchain structured markets protocol built for tokenized stocks on Robinhood Chain.

TALIS lets the same underlying asset serve two different market views. Holders can earn premium by giving up a defined portion of their future upside, while traders with stronger conviction can buy concentrated exposure to that upside.

Each market operates through defined periods with transparent pricing, strike levels and onchain settlement. Instead of relying on traditional perpetual leverage, funding rates or liquidation mechanics, upside positions are backed by the underlying assets locked within the protocol.

For holders, TALIS creates a way to generate income from assets they already own. For traders, it creates a way to isolate and trade the part of a market move they actually want.

One asset. Different outcomes.

100% of protocol revenue buys back $TALIS.

Built on Robinhood Chain.
